Lemma
[A characterization of Euclidean space (Lemma 27.9)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0030 ↗ prop:chow-iv-scalar-lower-equality 1. ch27:27.9\group Equality cases

If a complete Riemannian manifold admits $f$ with $ abla ^2f=g/2$, then it is isometric to Euclidean space. Indeed, after adding a constant, $f=| abla f|^2$, and $r=2\sqrt f$ has $| abla r|=1$ and $ abla ^2(r^2)=2g$; the homothetic level sets are round spheres.
